{{Quote|In our haste to escape, the navicomputer's coordinates were inputted incorrectly and, well, we're headed right for a star.|Clone Commander [[Bly/Legends|Bly]]|<ref name="JC" />}}
A '''star''' served as the [[Star/Legends|sun]] for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Maridun system/Legends|Maridun system]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a ''Consular''-class frigate piloted by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] nearly crashed into it due to incorrect coordinates and a damaged [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]].<ref name="JC" />
